await page.evaluate('async () => {\n  const g = document.querySelector(\'vaadin-grid\'); const seen = {};\n  const total = g.scrollHeight/33+5;\n  for (let idx=0; idx<=total; idx+=5){ g.scrollToIndex(idx); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));\n    for (const tr of g.shadowRoot.querySelectorAll(\'tbody tr\')){ const t=[...tr.querySelectorAll(\'td slot\')].map(s=>s.assignedNodes()[0]?.innerText?.trim()); if(t[2]) seen[t[2]]=t[3]+\' | \'+t[4]; } }\n  const all=Object.entries(seen); return {count:all.length, linens:all.filter(e=>e[1].includes(\'Linens\'))};\n}');
```
